senses.en: a sudden short period of illness
senses.pattern: a heart attack / an asthma attack / a panic attack
senses.example: He always carries an inhaler in case he has an asthma [[attack]] during PE class.
senses.example_zh: 他總是隨身帶著吸入器，以防體育課時氣喘發作。

senses.en: to criticize someone or something strongly
senses.pattern: attack a policy / attack a decision / be attacked for
senses.example: Several newspapers [[attacked]] the plan to cut down the old trees in the city park.
senses.example_zh: 數家報紙抨擊砍掉市立公園老樹的計畫。

gsat.sentence: The craze for hoops even resulted in dislocated backs and heart [[attacks]], according to medical records.
Conversely, worry can give a person an <u>ulcer</u>, high blood pressure, or even a heart [[attack]].

senses.en: a formal meeting with an important person
senses.pattern: an audience with the king / grant sb an audience / request an audience / a private audience
senses.example: After waiting for three months, the young explorer was finally granted an [[audience]] with the queen.
senses.example_zh: 等了三個月之後，這位年輕的探險家終於獲准謁見女王。

senses.en: the people who read, watch, or listen to a particular medium
senses.pattern: target audience / reach a wider audience / a young audience
senses.example: Her science blog reaches an [[audience]] of over fifty thousand readers in more than twenty countries.
senses.example_zh: 她的科學部落格擁有遍及二十多國、超過五萬人的讀者群。

gsat.sentence: Newspapers, radio and TV stations, and websites have participated in the April 1 tradition of making fictional reports in order to fool their [[audiences]].

senses.en: a group of people who act together
senses.pattern: a band of volunteers / a small band of followers / a band of thieves
senses.example: A small [[band]] of volunteers spent the weekend cleaning up the beach after the storm.
senses.example_zh: 一小群志工花了整個週末，在暴風雨過後清理海灘。

senses.en: a thin flat strip or ring; a stripe
senses.pattern: a rubber band / a hair band / a metal band / a band of color
senses.example: The bird has a narrow white [[band]] across each wing, which makes it easy to recognize.
senses.example_zh: 這種鳥的每隻翅膀上都有一道細細的白色條紋，因此很容易辨認。

gsat.sentence: The Maasai are a semi-nomadic group in Kenya and northern Tanzania, wandering in [[bands]] and living almost entirely on the meat, blood, and milk of their herds.
Moreover, each visitor is offered the option to wear a GPS Adventure [[Band]], which allows them to keep track of each other while in the park.

senses.en: to arrange in advance to have a seat, room, or ticket
senses.pattern: book a flight / book a table / book in advance / be fully booked
senses.example: We [[booked]] a table for six at the seafood restaurant to celebrate Grandma's birthday.
senses.example_zh: 我們在海鮮餐廳預訂了六人的桌位，替奶奶慶生。

senses.en: written records of the money a business receives and spends
senses.pattern: keep the books / balance the books / check the company's books
senses.example: My aunt keeps the [[books]] for her flower shop and checks every payment at night.
senses.example_zh: 我阿姨負責管理她那間花店的帳簿，每晚核對每一筆款項。
senses.note: 此義用複數 books

gsat.sentence: Having saved enough money, Joy [[booked]] two trips for this summer vacation, one to France and the other to Australia.

senses.en: to be in charge of a meeting or committee
senses.pattern: chair a meeting / chair a committee / chair the discussion
senses.example: Professor Lin was invited to [[chair]] the committee that selects this year's scholarship winners.
senses.example_zh: 林教授受邀主持遴選今年獎學金得主的委員會。

senses.en: the person in charge of a meeting or committee
senses.pattern: the chair of the committee / be elected chair / address the chair
senses.example: As [[chair]] of the student council, Mia opens every meeting with a short report.
senses.example_zh: 身為學生會主席，米亞每次開會都先做簡短報告。
senses.note: 也可說 chairperson

senses.en: to make something less clear or confuse someone's judgment
senses.pattern: cloud one's judgment / cloud the issue / cloud one's memory
senses.example: The passing years have [[clouded]] my grandfather's memory of the village where he grew up.
senses.example_zh: 歲月流逝，使祖父對他成長的那個村莊的記憶變得模糊。

senses.en: something that causes worry, sadness, or suspicion
senses.pattern: cast a cloud over sth / under a cloud / a cloud of suspicion
senses.example: The injury to the team's best player cast a [[cloud]] over the final game.
senses.example_zh: 隊上最佳球員受傷，讓決賽蒙上一層陰影。
senses.note: a cloud of dust 指「一團塵土」

senses.en: a thick heavy stick; a stick for hitting a golf ball
senses.pattern: a golf club / a set of clubs / a wooden club / swing a club
senses.example: The golfer chose a heavier [[club]] for the long shot across the lake.
senses.example_zh: 那位高爾夫球選手選了一支較重的球桿，來打這記越過湖面的長桿。
senses.note: 撲克牌的「梅花」也是 clubs

senses.en: to invent a new word or phrase
senses.pattern: coin a term / coin a phrase / coin a new word
senses.example: The term “smog” was [[coined]] in the early 1900s by combining the words “smoke” and “fog.”
senses.example_zh: 「smog」一詞是二十世紀初結合 smoke 與 fog 兩字所創造出來的。
senses.note: to coin a phrase 套句俗話說

senses.en: to go and get something, or receive money owed
senses.pattern: collect a prize / collect taxes / collect the rent / collect a parcel
senses.example: Winners must [[collect]] their prizes at the school office before Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 得獎者必須在星期五下午之前到學校辦公室領取獎品。

senses.en: to bring your thoughts or feelings under control
senses.pattern: collect your thoughts / collect yourself / pause to collect oneself
senses.example: She paused for a moment to [[collect]] her thoughts before answering the interviewer's difficult question.
senses.example_zh: 她停頓片刻整理思緒，才回答面試官的難題。
senses.note: collected (adj.) 鎮定的，如 calm and collected

senses.en: to influence someone's opinion or judgment, often unfairly
senses.pattern: color one's judgment / color one's view / be colored by experience
senses.example: Don't let one bad experience [[color]] your opinion of the whole country and its people.
senses.example_zh: 別讓一次不好的經驗影響你對整個國家及其人民的看法。

senses.en: interesting and lively details or qualities
senses.pattern: local color / add color to / full of color
senses.example: The street musicians and night markets add local [[color]] to the old harbor town.
senses.example_zh: 街頭藝人和夜市為這座古老的港口小鎮增添了地方特色。
senses.note: local color＝地方色彩

senses.en: (of problems) to follow and trouble someone for a long time
senses.pattern: be dogged by injury / be dogged by bad luck / dog sb's footsteps
senses.example: The talented pitcher has been [[dogged]] by shoulder injuries ever since he joined the team.
senses.example_zh: 這位有天分的投手自從加入球隊後，就一直受肩傷困擾。
senses.note: 多用被動 be dogged by…

senses.en: to look at someone or something carefully or with interest
senses.pattern: eye someone suspiciously / eye the cake hungrily / eye each other warily
senses.example: The cat sat by the window and [[eyed]] the birds in the garden hungrily.
senses.example_zh: 那隻貓坐在窗邊，虎視眈眈地注視著花園裡的鳥兒。

senses.en: a natural ability to notice or judge things well
senses.pattern: have an eye for detail / a good eye for color / a keen eye
senses.example: With her sharp [[eye]] for detail, Nora quickly spotted three mistakes in the report.
senses.example_zh: 諾拉對細節的眼光敏銳，很快就找出報告裡的三個錯誤。
senses.note: 此義用單數：have an eye for

senses.en: very thin or small; delicate, subtle, or precise
senses.pattern: fine sand / fine hair / a fine line / fine details
senses.example: The old books were covered with dust so [[fine]] that it rose into the air at the lightest touch.
senses.example_zh: 那些舊書上蒙著的灰塵非常細小，輕輕一碰就飛揚起來。

senses.en: money that must be paid as a punishment
senses.pattern: pay a fine / a heavy fine / a parking fine / a fine for littering
senses.example: Anyone caught littering in the national park must pay a [[fine]] of three thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 凡是在國家公園亂丟垃圾被抓到的人，必須繳交三千元罰款。

senses.en: to make someone pay money as a punishment
senses.pattern: be fined for speeding / fine sb $100 / be heavily fined
senses.example: The factory was [[fined]] heavily for pouring polluted water into the river.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠因為把污水排入河中，被處以鉅額罰款。

gsat.sentence: With a continuous 3 km stretch of golden sand, the beach attracts artists around the world each summer to create amazing sculptures with its [[fine]] soft sand.
Willig was honored in a party and [[fined]] only $1.10.

senses.en: to visit a place often
senses.pattern: frequent a café / be frequented by tourists / frequent the library
senses.example: The old bookstore he [[frequented]] as a boy has since been turned into a convenience store.
senses.example_zh: 他小時候常去的那家舊書店，後來已改成便利商店。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /frɪˈkwɛnt/，重音在後

senses.en: the period during which something lasts or works
senses.pattern: shelf life / battery life / extend the life of
senses.example: Regular cleaning and oiling can double the [[life]] of a bicycle chain.
senses.example_zh: 定期清潔和上油，可以讓腳踏車鏈條的使用壽命加倍。

senses.en: energy, activity, and liveliness
senses.pattern: full of life / come to life / bring sth to life
senses.example: The night market was full of [[life]], with vendors shouting and children running between the stalls.
senses.example_zh: 夜市充滿活力，攤販大聲叫賣，孩子們在攤位間跑來跑去。

senses.en: the punishment of staying in prison until death
senses.pattern: be sentenced to life / get life / life in prison
senses.example: The judge sentenced the man to [[life]] for a crime that had shocked the whole country.
senses.example_zh: 法官因這起震驚全國的罪行，判處該名男子無期徒刑。
senses.note: 即 life imprisonment

gsat.sentence: Moisture and oxygen promote oxidation and therefore limit its shelf [[life]].

senses.en: to work at or operate a place or machine
senses.pattern: man the desk / man the phones / man a booth / a manned spacecraft
senses.example: Student volunteers [[manned]] the information desk all day during the school anniversary fair.
senses.example_zh: 校慶園遊會期間，學生志工整天在服務台值班。
senses.note: manned 有人駕駛的；unmanned 無人的

senses.en: to show that something important is happening
senses.pattern: mark the beginning of / mark the end of / mark a turning point
senses.example: The invention of the printing press [[marked]] the beginning of a new age of learning.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明標誌著一個新學習時代的開端。

senses.en: to celebrate or officially remember an important event
senses.pattern: mark the anniversary / mark the occasion / mark the centenary of
senses.example: The school planted a hundred trees to [[mark]] its one hundredth anniversary.
senses.example_zh: 學校種了一百棵樹來紀念創校一百週年。

gsat.sentence: The news made headlines around the world, not only for the incredible achievement of the search team, but because the discovery [[marked]] the final chapter in a legendary story of extraordinary courage and perseverance.

Last week Jay McCarroll and The HSUS (The Humane Society of the United States) made a bold fur-free statement on the runway, [[marking]] <u>a new chapter</u> for the fashion industry and animal protection.

senses.en: the place where a river meets the sea; an opening
senses.pattern: the mouth of the river / the mouth of a cave / a river mouth
senses.example: The fishing village lies at the [[mouth]] of the river, where fresh water meets the sea.
senses.example_zh: 這個漁村位於河口，也就是淡水與海水交會的地方。

senses.en: to form words with the lips without making a sound
senses.pattern: mouth the words / mouth a silent thank-you / mouth something to someone
senses.example: From across the noisy room, she [[mouthed]] the words "call me later" and pointed to her phone.
senses.example_zh: 隔著吵雜的房間，她用嘴形無聲地說了「晚點打給我」，並指了指她的手機。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /maʊð/，字尾發濁音

senses.en: an action taken to achieve something
senses.pattern: a smart move / a bold move / make a move / a move to cut costs
senses.example: Lowering ticket prices was a smart [[move]] that brought thousands of new visitors to the museum.
senses.example_zh: 調降票價是明智的舉措，為博物館帶來數千名新訪客。

senses.en: to cause someone to do something
senses.pattern: move sb to do sth / be moved to act / feel moved to help
senses.example: The photos of hungry children [[moved]] many viewers to donate money to the relief fund.
senses.example_zh: 那些飢餓孩童的照片促使許多觀眾捐款給救濟基金。
senses.note: 另義：I move that…＝（會議中）提議

senses.en: new and different from anything known before
senses.pattern: a novel idea / a novel approach / a novel solution / a novel way
senses.example: The engineers came up with a [[novel]] way to turn ocean waves into electricity.
senses.example_zh: 工程師們想出一種新穎的方法，把海浪轉換成電力。
senses.note: 名詞 novelty：新奇（的事物）

senses.en: to amount to a particular total
senses.pattern: number in the thousands / number more than 200 / number about fifty
senses.example: The crowd at the free outdoor concert [[numbered]] more than five thousand by sunset.
senses.example_zh: 到了日落時分，這場免費戶外音樂會的觀眾總計超過五千人。
senses.note: 後面直接接數字，不用被動

senses.en: a song or dance in a performance
senses.pattern: a dance number / the opening number / the final number
senses.example: For the final [[number]], the band invited the whole audience to sing along.
senses.example_zh: 表演最後一首曲目時，樂團邀請全場觀眾一起合唱。

senses.en: as soon as; from the moment that
senses.pattern: once you start / once it is done / once opened
senses.example: [[Once]] you understand the basic rule, the rest of the grammar becomes much easier.
senses.example_zh: 一旦你理解了基本規則，其餘的文法就會變得容易許多。
senses.note: once 子句用現在式代替未來式

gsat.sentence: And [[once]] an opinion is formed, most of their thinking then is simply trying to find support for it.
But baby elephants, not used to negotiating rough ground, may easily fall into the trenches and get hurt; and [[once]] injured, they might not be able to climb out.

senses.en: honest and not keeping your feelings secret
senses.pattern: be open with someone / be open about one's feelings / open and honest
senses.example: Teenagers are more [[open]] with their parents when they feel listened to rather than judged.
senses.example_zh: 當青少年覺得父母是在傾聽而非批判時，會對父母更坦率。
senses.note: be open with＋人；be open about＋事

senses.en: not yet decided or answered
senses.pattern: an open question / leave the matter open / remain open
senses.example: Whether robots will ever replace human teachers remains an [[open]] question.
senses.example_zh: 機器人是否終將取代人類教師，仍是個懸而未決的問題。
senses.note: be open to＝願意接受；容易受到

senses.en: no longer burning or shining
senses.pattern: go out / put out a fire / blow out the candles / the lights are out
senses.example: The campers made sure the fire was completely [[out]] before they went to sleep in their tents.
senses.example_zh: 露營的人確認營火完全熄滅後，才進帳篷睡覺。

senses.en: available for the public to buy or see
senses.pattern: come out / be out now / be out in stores
senses.example: The singer's new album has been [[out]] for only a week, but it already tops the charts.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手的新專輯才問世一週，就已登上排行榜冠軍。

senses.en: a period of three months, especially in business
senses.pattern: the first quarter / next quarter / profits for the quarter
senses.example: The company's sales rose by ten percent in the third [[quarter]] of the year.
senses.example_zh: 該公司今年第三季的銷售額成長了百分之十。
senses.note: 形容詞、副詞為 quarterly（每季的）

senses.en: a district of a town or city
senses.pattern: the old quarter / the historic quarter / a residential quarter
senses.example: Tourists love to wander through the old [[quarter]] of the city, with its narrow stone streets.
senses.example_zh: 遊客喜歡漫步於這座城市的舊城區，那裡有狹窄的石板街道。
senses.note: 複數 quarters 指宿舍、住處

gsat.sentence: If all the manufacturers can hang on during this financial crisis, the economy may get better next [[quarter]].

senses.en: a customer who often goes to a shop or restaurant
senses.pattern: a regular at the café / one of the regulars / greet the regulars
senses.example: The owner knows all her [[regulars]] by name and remembers how each one likes their coffee.
senses.example_zh: 老闆娘叫得出所有常客的名字，也記得每個人喝咖啡的習慣。

senses.en: ordinary, or of medium size
senses.pattern: regular size / the regular price / a regular classroom
senses.example: You don't need special shoes for this hike; [[regular]] sneakers will be perfectly fine.
senses.example_zh: 這趟健行不需要特殊的鞋子，普通的運動鞋就完全可以了。

gsat.sentence: Sasaki stated in an interview: “Because my thoughts couldn’t be passed on through a [[regular]] phone line, I wanted them to be carried on the wind.”
In this line of work, the person is paid to do daring actions that are deemed too risky for the [[regular]] actor to perform, including jumping from heights, crashing cars, or fighting with weapons.

senses.en: to be someone's responsibility; to depend on something
senses.pattern: rest with the principal / the decision rests with / rest on evidence / success rests on
senses.example: The final decision on the school trip [[rests]] with the principal, not the teachers.
senses.example_zh: 校外教學的最終決定權在於校長，而不是老師。
senses.note: rest with＋人；rest on＋事物

senses.en: to support something by putting it on something else
senses.pattern: rest one's head on / rest one's elbows on / rest a ladder against the wall
senses.example: Tired from the long hike, she [[rested]] her head on her backpack and closed her eyes.
senses.example_zh: 走了很久的山路累壞了，她把頭靠在背包上，閉上眼睛。

senses.en: to dismiss someone from a job
senses.pattern: sack a worker / be sacked for being late / get the sack
senses.example: The coach was [[sacked]] after the team lost ten games in a row.
senses.example_zh: 球隊十連敗後，教練遭到解雇。
senses.note: 英式口語；get the sack 指「被解雇」

senses.en: to destroy and rob a captured town or city
senses.pattern: sack a city / sack the town / be sacked by invaders
senses.example: The invading army [[sacked]] the ancient city and carried away its treasures.
senses.example_zh: 入侵的軍隊洗劫了這座古城，並帶走城裡的寶物。

senses.en: to test or check people for a disease or suitability
senses.pattern: screen for cancer / be screened for / screen passengers / screen applicants
senses.example: All newborn babies in the hospital are [[screened]] for hearing problems before they go home.
senses.example_zh: 這家醫院所有的新生兒在回家前都要接受聽力篩檢。
senses.note: 名詞 screening：篩檢；放映

senses.en: to show a film or television program
senses.pattern: screen a film / screen a documentary / be screened on TV
senses.example: The documentary about sea turtles will be [[screened]] in the school hall this Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 這部關於海龜的紀錄片將於本週五下午在學校禮堂放映。

senses.en: a female member of a religious order
senses.pattern: Sister Mary / the sisters of the convent / a Catholic sister
senses.example: The [[sisters]] at the convent run a free clinic for poor families in the mountains.
senses.example_zh: 修道院的修女們為山區的貧困家庭開辦免費診所。
senses.note: 作稱呼時大寫，如 Sister Mary

senses.en: belonging to the same group or closely linked
senses.pattern: a sister school / a sister city / a sister company / a sister ship
senses.example: Every summer, our school sends twenty students to its [[sister]] school in Japan for two weeks.
senses.example_zh: 每年夏天，我們學校會派二十名學生到日本的姊妹校交流兩週。
senses.note: 只用於名詞前

senses.zh: 使（自己）堅強、做好心理準備
senses.en: to prepare yourself for something difficult or unpleasant
senses.pattern: steel oneself for / steel oneself to do / steel oneself against
senses.example: Mia [[steeled]] herself for bad news as the doctor slowly opened the envelope with her test results.
senses.example_zh: 當醫生緩緩打開裝有檢查結果的信封時，米亞使自己堅強起來，做好心理準備面對壞消息。
senses.note: 受詞多為反身代名詞 oneself

senses.en: to show or indicate that something is probably true
senses.pattern: evidence suggests that / studies suggest that / the results suggest / as the name suggests
senses.example: The footprints in the mud [[suggest]] that a large animal passed by the camp last night.
senses.example_zh: 泥地上的腳印顯示，昨晚有大型動物經過營地。
senses.note: 此義的 that 子句不用（should）＋原形

gsat.sentence: This [[suggests]] that napping may significantly delay age-related brain shrinkage, and thus lower the possibility of developing dementia.
In the Old Testament, reference is made to spiral staircases in the Temple of Solomon, [[suggesting]] that they were already in use by around 1,000 BC.

senses.en: to spread quickly through a place
senses.pattern: sweep the country / sweep the nation / sweep through the city / sweep across Europe
senses.example: Wildfires [[swept]] the dry hillsides last summer, forcing thousands of residents to leave their homes.
senses.example_zh: 去年夏天野火席捲乾燥的山坡，迫使數千名居民撤離家園。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 swept

senses.en: to look quickly over a whole area
senses.pattern: sweep the room / sweep the horizon / sb's eyes sweep the crowd
senses.example: The lifeguard's eyes [[swept]] the beach for any swimmers who might be in trouble.
senses.example_zh: 救生員的目光掃視海灘，尋找任何可能遇上麻煩的泳客。

senses.en: to need a lot of effort; to put a strain on
senses.pattern: tax sb's patience / tax one's strength / tax resources
senses.example: Looking after three young children all day really [[taxes]] her patience.
senses.example_zh: 整天照顧三個年幼的孩子，實在很考驗她的耐心。
senses.note: taxing（adj.）費力的、累人的

senses.en: however; used to add a contrasting comment
senses.pattern: …, though. / It was fun, though. / Thanks, though.
senses.example: The hike to the waterfall was exhausting; the view at the top was worth it, [[though]].
senses.example_zh: 走到瀑布的那段路累死人了，不過山頂的景色很值得。
senses.note: 口語常用；多置於句尾，前加逗號

gsat.sentence: I did NOT like the price, [[though]].
Not all dimples are formed by a genetic defect, [[though]]; some may appear due to the presence of excessive fat on the face.

senses.en: complete; absolute
senses.pattern: a total failure / total darkness / a total stranger / total silence
senses.example: The surprise party was a [[total]] failure because the birthday girl had already heard about it.
senses.example_zh: 這場驚喜派對是個徹底的失敗，因為壽星早就聽說了這件事。

senses.en: to reach a particular total amount
senses.pattern: total $500 / total over a million / total nearly 300
senses.example: Donations to the animal shelter [[totaled]] nearly three million dollars by the end of the year.
senses.example_zh: 到年底時，動物收容所收到的捐款總計達將近三百萬元。
senses.note: 英式拼法為 totalled

gsat.sentence: Global sales of hard hats [[totaled]] USD 2.1 billion in 2016, and are expected to reach USD 3.19 billion in 2025.

senses.en: to catch your foot on something and fall
senses.pattern: trip over / trip on / trip and fall / trip sb up
senses.example: Running down the dark hallway, I [[tripped]] over a schoolbag and hurt my knee.
senses.example_zh: 我在昏暗的走廊上奔跑時，被一個書包絆倒，傷了膝蓋。
senses.note: 過去式 tripped，重複字尾 p

senses.en: to set off an alarm or switch
senses.pattern: trip an alarm / trip a switch / trip the circuit breaker
senses.example: A cat walking across the yard [[tripped]] the alarm and woke the whole neighborhood.
senses.example_zh: 一隻貓走過院子時觸發了警報，把整個社區的人都吵醒。

senses.en: to reach or pass a particular age or time
senses.pattern: turn 18 / turn thirty / have just turned sixty / it has just turned midnight
senses.example: My grandmother [[turns]] ninety next month, and the whole family is planning a surprise party.
senses.example_zh: 我奶奶下個月就滿九十歲了，全家人正在籌劃一場驚喜派對。
senses.note: 後面直接接年齡，不加 to

senses.en: a change in a situation or in the way something develops
senses.pattern: an unexpected turn / take a turn for the worse / the turn of the century
senses.example: The story takes an unexpected [[turn]] when the detective discovers a second letter.
senses.example_zh: 當偵探發現第二封信時，故事出現了意想不到的轉折。
senses.note: the turn of the century＝世紀之交

gsat.sentence: Some see it as a celebration related to the [[turn]] of the seasons from winter to spring; others, however, believe that it stems from the adoption of a new calendar.

senses.en: a legal document about your property after death
senses.pattern: make a will / leave sth in a will / a last will
senses.example: In his [[will]], the old farmer left all of his land to the village school.
senses.example_zh: 老農夫在遺囑中把所有土地都留給了村裡的學校。

senses.en: the mental power to decide and act
senses.pattern: the will to live / free will / against one's will / strength of will
senses.example: Despite the pain in her knee, the runner finished the race through sheer strength of [[will]].
senses.example_zh: 儘管膝蓋疼痛，這位跑者仍憑著過人的意志力跑完全程。

senses.en: to be effective or produce the intended result
senses.pattern: the plan worked / work well / work wonders
senses.example: I tried several ways to remove the ink stain, but none of them [[worked]].
senses.example_zh: 我試了好幾種方法去除墨漬，但沒有一種奏效。

senses.en: a book, painting, or piece of music
senses.pattern: a work of art / the complete works of / literary works
senses.example: The library holds the complete [[works]] of the poet, including her early unpublished letters.
senses.example_zh: 圖書館收藏了這位詩人的全部作品，包括她早期未發表的書信。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞

gsat.sentence: If that [[works]], human trials will be next on the agenda.
It was the only national park established because of Moran’s [[works]].

quiz.stem: Before being allowed to donate blood, all volunteers are carefully ______ for infectious diseases to make sure the blood is safe for patients.
quiz.explain_zh: screen＝篩檢。捐血前，所有自願捐血者都須接受傳染病篩檢，以確保血液安全。

quiz.stem: Knowing that the judges would be strict, Jason ______ himself for harsh comments before he walked onto the stage to sing.
quiz.explain_zh: steel＝使（自己）堅強起來。傑森上台前先做好心理準備，迎接嚴厲的評語。

quiz.stem: Carrying heavy equipment up the mountain for ten hours would ______ the strength of even the most experienced hiker.
quiz.explain_zh: tax＝使負重擔、考驗。扛重裝備爬山十小時，對老手的體力也是考驗。

quiz.stem: A wave of excitement is ______ the country as the national badminton team advances to the final of the world championship.
quiz.explain_zh: sweep＝席捲。國家羽球隊打進世錦賽決賽，興奮的熱潮席捲全國。

quiz.stem: Because no one had ever tried it before, the team's ______ approach to recycling plastic bottles attracted attention from scientists around the world.
quiz.explain_zh: novel＝新穎的。這個從來沒人試過的回收方法很新穎，因而受到各國科學家注意。

quiz.stem: Doctors are trained to stay calm in emergencies, because strong emotions can ______ their judgment and lead to serious mistakes.
quiz.explain_zh: cloud＝影響（判斷）。強烈的情緒會影響醫生的判斷而導致失誤。

quiz.stem: The dark clouds gathering over the mountains and the sudden drop in temperature ______ that a storm is on its way.
quiz.explain_zh: suggest＝顯示、暗示。山上的烏雲和氣溫驟降顯示暴風雨即將來臨。

quiz.stem: The noodle shop has been open for forty years, and many of its ______ have eaten there every week since they were children.
quiz.explain_zh: regular＝常客。麵店許多老主顧從小就每週來吃。

quiz.stem: When more families began spending their holidays at home to save money, the word “staycation” was ______ to describe this new kind of vacation.
quiz.explain_zh: coin＝創造（新詞語）。人們創造 staycation 一詞來形容在家度假的新方式。

quiz.stem: The small café near the harbor is ______ by local artists, who gather there every evening to share ideas and show their latest paintings.
quiz.explain_zh: frequent＝常去、常光顧。當地藝術家每晚都到那家咖啡館聚會。
